function.name: file_read
function.description: Read up to 500 captured source lines. The response includes exact source and a citation receipt. Limited coverage cannot prove absence.

function.name: code_search
function.description: Search captured source. Return up to 100 exact source ranges with receipts. Limited or unavailable coverage cannot prove absence.

function.name: file_find
function.description: Find captured repository paths by a name or subpath. Return up to 100 paths. Paths are not source citations.

function.name: file_read_diff
function.description: Read the supplied captured group diffs. Diff text is not a source citation.

function.name: verification_submit
function.description: Submit candidate-local decisions. Copy complete citation receipts unchanged from source responses. Set complete only when the investigation ends.
